Step 2/3 — Click "Publish"; verify the Publish wizard opens with a Version-name input on its Preparation step (case text describes a single dialog — live product is a 3-step wizard, CLARIFICATION #612)
Step 4 — Enter version name, select Category, accept Publishing Terms, click "Continue"
